title_sq: Tek 21-Dhjetori, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimteri Te Rregullt!!
description_sq: Tek 21-Dhjetori, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 8(i fundit) te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet ne korridorin shperndares, sallonin e ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon, i cili eshte pershtatur si ambient gatimi, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara si per banim edhe per investim, pasi kerkesat per qira jane te larta. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Until December 21, 1+1 apartment with regular layout for sale!!
description_en: Until December 21, 1+1 apartment with regular floor plan for sale!! The property is located on the 8th (top) floor of a well-managed building with an elevator and is organized in the distribution corridor, the living room with access to the balcony, which is adapted as a kitchen, bedroom and toilet. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for both residence and investment, as the demand for rent is high. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
